::: {#def-complete-graph}
#### Complete graph

For a positive integer $n$, a **complete graph** $K_n$ [@wikipedia_complete_graph] is a simple graph (@def-simple-graph) with $n$ vertices
in which every two different vertices are adjacent (@def-adjacent).
Two complete graphs with $n$ vertices differ only in the names of their vertices,
so we write $K_n$ for any of them.

:::
